_comment: Sidecar for scripts/build_checklist_status.py. Everything here is judgement
the parser will not fake. Edit this file, then re-run the script.
classify  — items whose **Status:** line is prose rather than a [~]/[?]
marker. Without an entry the parser defaults to not_started
reconcile — items whose recorded state is behind what the code actually
does. Delete an entry once the markdown is ticked; the script
Backticks, **bold**, and *italic* in prose fields render as markup.

page.lede: Item counts by ID prefix for master_checklist.md, and whether anything is still recorded behind what the code actually does. Generated by `scripts/build_checklist_status.py` — do not hand-edit.
why_stopped: Ticking the register drifted out of sync with the work. Between 2026-08-15 and 2026-08-17 the conversation ran on direct questions — licensing, legacy dead code, contracts, CLOCCS, diagrams, CLEAN-01, archiving, commit grouping — and each was answered against the *code* rather than against this checklist. Items kept closing; the boxes did not get ticked.

That gap has now been worked off. The 2026-08-18 pass ticked UI-03, UI-04, REL-02, REL-03, and FEAT-02 and closed MODEL-01 and MODEL-05; the 2026-08-19 pass closed the last three reconciliation items by reading the code — **LEGACY-01** and **UI-01** ticked in full, **DOC-03** recorded as `[~]` with the two documents that still describe deleted files named in the item. Every count below is now read straight from the markdown, with no overrides applied.

notices.title: Reconciliation cannot be recovered from `git log`.
notices.body: None of the 11 commits between `07543c9` and `fd74f10` carry an issue ID, which breaks the checklist's own rule at `master_checklist.md:26` (`fix(MODEL-02): …`). The mapping below was rebuilt by reading source, not history. Tagging future commits with their issue ID is what stops this table from being needed at all.

page.reconcile_footnote: Empty is the goal state: every item's recorded status now matches what the code does, so nothing needs an override. Blocked status is still resolved transitively — an item whose only blocker is done is reported unblocked without an entry here. UI-12 left this table that way when UI-03 was ticked.

followups.title: UI-10 may be moot.
followups.body: The item is *"Run All does not run all"*. `run_all` and the whole index-dispatch layer were deleted in `5ac4956`, so the behaviour it describes no longer exists. Confirm, then close it as obsolete rather than fixed.

followups.title: QC-CAL-01 is the highest-leverage open item in the file.
followups.body: The shared calibration study alone gates QC-01, QC-03, QC-04, QC-06, and STAT-01's threshold item. It needs labelled acquisitions covering clogs, dropouts, timer rollover, backward time jumps, doublet-heavy and debris-dominant samples, which the project does not yet have.

AMBIG-01.why: status reads 'documented in help, not handled in code' — the help text exists, the code path does not

FUTURE-01.why: status reads 'correctly deferred' — deliberately out of scope, not blocked by anything

FEAT-01.why: a cross-reference to UI-13 with no sub-items of its own; counted here so the group totals stay complete

FEAT-04.why: cloccs is registered and its worker, client, generator, and unit suite all exist; all three validation boxes are open
